findings.problem: The hint 'informal' still allows '¿Cuál es tu nombre?', a correct and fairly common informal Latin American way to ask someone's name.
findings.fix: hint: informal; the everyday way, literally "how do you call yourself?"

back.es: How do you (informal) call yourself? = What's your name? (informal)
back.example: Hi, what's your name? —My name is Ana.

note: The new hint matches the wording of this unit's "My name is..." card, so the two cards point to the same llamarse pattern.
